Shape.Name: Sheet.81
Shape.Text: The following tips apply to all the diagrams in the Functional Block Diagram set. Use the Pan and Zoom navigation tool on the left pane to view diagram details. To see more information about a component or cable, Ctrl + Click the object. Information will be displayed on the left pane. J#s on the edge of a cabinet indicate the connector’s location on the cabinet’s I/O panel. Search within a page for a part by typing in its name or part number, and then select the relevant search result.

Shape.Name: Sheet.1597
Shape.Text:
The Host PC is connected to the Gradient chain through the Ethernet Switch. The Gradient information, in turn, passes through the Ethernet Switch to the CAM Chassis via the AGP Board. From the AGP board, information is passed to the PSE board via the CAM backplane. The PSE board operates as the brains of the process, passing the signal on to the other two boards via the CAM backplane.
Once fully processed the signal is sent to the Cronus Chassis in the XGD before the Gradient Pulse is generated.

Shape.Name: Sheet.1633
Shape.Text: Diagnostic Data Path: Gradient Hammer Test

Shape.Name: Sheet.1634
Shape.Text: The Gradient Hammer Test data path originates in: 1. The PSE and passes to the IXG, 2. From the IXG, the signal passes to the Cronus Chassis GMC Board, then to 3. The XGAs, via the Cronus backplane.

Shape.Name: Sheet.1643
Shape.Text: Diagnostic Data Path: Static Test Fidelity Diagnostic

Shape.Name: Sheet.1644
Shape.Text: The Static Test and Fidelity Diagnostic data paths originate in: 1. The Cronus Chassis GMC board and pass 2. To the XGAs, via the Cronus backplane.

Shape.Name: Sheet.1619
Shape.Text:
When diagnostics are initiated by the FE, 1. Status/control path originates in the Host, and passes to the Ethernet Switch, then 2. To the SCP. The SCP translates the command and passes it to either the Ethernet Switch or the PSE board (depending on which diagnostic is requested). 2,3. When a Static Test or Fidelity Diagnostic is requested, the SCP passes the translated command to Cronus Chassis GMC board via the Ethernet Switch, and the GMC board executes the command. 4. When a Gradient Hammer Test is requested, the SCP passes the translated command to the PSE board, which executes the command.
Real-time diagnostic execution involves the following path: 5. From the PSE to the IXG, then 6. To the Cronus Chassis GMC board, then, 7. To the XGA Control Board, via the Cronus backplane, and to the XGAs So if there are multiple failures, the failure in the later steps will not come to light until the failure in the earlier step has been addressed.

Shape.Name: Sheet.1595
Shape.Text: The signal path for the boards in the CAM Chassis passes through the boards in the following order: 1. Waveform commands originate in the AGP and are passed on to the PSE. 2. From the PSE to the IXG, via the backplane, 3. From the IXG to the Cronus Chassis, GMC board. 4,5. The clock signal originates in the Exciter and is passed to the Cronus Chassis GMC board, and CAM IXG board for synchronization. 6. Gradient Pulse and clock signals are passed from the GMC to the XGAs for pulse creation.
